/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/App.tsx')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"{metric === 'visitors' ? 'Посетители' : 'Сессии'}, чел.\", \"{metric === 'visitors' ? 'Посетители, чел.' : 'Сессии'}\").replace(\"data={data.map(d => metric === 'sessions' ? {...d, current: Math.round(d.current / 1.32), previous: Math.round(d.previous / 1.32)} : d)}\", \"data={data}\")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('index.html')
s=p.read_text().replace('<html lang=\"en\">','<html lang=\"ru\">').replace('<title>Gravity UI eval</title>', '<meta name=\"theme-color\" content=\"#16886d\" />\\n    <meta name=\"description\" content=\"Pulse — аналитика вашего проекта. p.write_text(s)
PY
npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/App.css index.html"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'data=|чел|html lang|title|useState|modal-backdrop' src/App.tsx index.html && npm install --no-save --package-lock=false playwright"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/App.css index.html && npm run build'
